# Pump cabinet

Two direct-on-line motor starters, controlled and monitored by a WAGO 750 PLC through two
interface relays.

The upstream board protects the incoming cable with a C16 breaker. The cable lands there on
terminals +EXT-X0, the only part of the upstream board in this model.

document.cover:
# Two-pump station, system

Project EX-1, revision 1.1.

The station: the pump cabinet +C1 and, external to it (+EXT), the two pump motors, the network
switch and the upstream distribution board's terminals, joined by their cables.

revision.text: No mate, board unit or harness line: the interface relays are wired in the cabinet, and the Ethernet link is a cable (R1216, R1253)
Pump cabinet 1.9: terminal strip X01 is X4, breaker F01 is F1 (R1114)
Unit tags, links, busbars and rail bonds, energy on fed supplies
Pump contact blocks LADN22: the running feedback leaves on the block's second make contact, 83-84 (R780)
Three phases on four terminals each, pump n on terminal n+2
Terminal strip X01 is X4 and breaker F01 is F1: a tag takes no leading zero (R1114)
Pump cabinet 1.10: no mate, board unit or harness line; the Ethernet link W3 is a cable
TeSys D parts, 24V and GND rails, IEC wire colours
The cabinet is a unit with no place of its own (owner ruling 2026-10-06)

Owner ruling 2026-10-06, a cabinet is a unit: the place C1 is gone. The change list reads No changes. because the listing drops a place that holds the whole unit, baseline L2, kept by design (REL-DIFF-PLACE)
